name: writer
summary: Templates for writers: essayists, bloggers, authors, content and technical writers. Covers the decisions that shape a piece and a body of work, plus a pattern template and session log. The published draft carries what you said. The vault carries why you said it that way, what you cut, and what you chose not to claim.

templates.use: The angle, take, framing, or what to cut
A piece's format, scope, venue, and where it stands
Tracking a claim, figure, source, or permission
Generic starting point for any writing decision
A reusable writing move worth naming
What happened in a writing session
